      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/index/base.* and src/index/txindex.* to support running txindex alongside pruning via an updated prune policy and virtual block references.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Removes the long-standing mutual exclusion between -txindex and -prune, allowing storage-constrained nodes to index transactions without keeping hundreds of gigabytes of raw block history on disk. It also enables pruned nodes to track starting height and surface candidate block hashes for on-demand retrieval."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Extends JSONRPCError and src/rpc/util.* to support structured error data payloads reporting candidate block hashes across rawtransaction and REST endpoints.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Enhances RPC error handling to carry structured metadata (candidate block hashes) when lookups hit pruned blocks, allowing downstream clients to fetch missing blocks programmatically."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to test_runner.py merely register the new feature_txindex_prune.py test and do not modify test framework infrastructure.",
